newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Elec & Eltek plans shift to higher-valued PCBs.
newsitem.headline: Elec & Eltek plans shift to higher-valued PCBs.

text.p: Elec & Eltek International Co Ltd said on Monday it plans to move into higher-valued, multi-layered printed circuit boards (PCB) and expand production in cheaper countries like China and Thailand.

The company, a PCB and component maker controlled by Elec & Eltek International Holdings in Hong Kong, said in its results for the year ending June 30 1996 the plan was part of a strategy to counter market difficulties in the electronic sector.
It said uncertainty was expected to persist, but the electronics sector should recover by the end of 1996 or in the first quarter of 1997.
The company announced a growth of 33.4 percent in net profits to Singapore $49.05 million.
